mathematics.reason: Maths interpreter: FAIL. The definition states that the intersection of all clusters must be empty (∩ᵢcᵢ = ∅), but this condition is weaker than the standard partition requirement. A proper partition requires pairwise disjointness (cᵢ ∩ cⱼ = ∅ for all i ≠ j), not merely that the global intersection of all clusters simultaneously is empty. For example, three sets {a,b}, {b,c}, {a,c} have an empty three-way intersection yet are not pairwise disjoint and would not constitute a valid partition of features. The intended meaning — that clusters do not overlap — requires pairwise disjointness, which is a strictly stronger condition than what is written. The transcription was confirmed faithful to the paper, so the issue lies in the definition itself, not in copying.
